prompt: Use case: style-transfer, precise portrait correction. Asset: Stronghold Protocol strategy icon, ONE square transparent PNG. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL CHARACTER EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the user's actual game screenshot: the five portraits along the top row are the POSITIVE STYLE TARGET; the bright green round Chen Qianyu portrait at bottom left is the NEGATIVE EXAMPLE to fix. Image 3 is a correctly styled original strategy asset (Fang); its subtle partially transparent portrait shading and alpha falloff matter. Preserve the source character from image 1: charcoal hair and blue/pink horns, gold hair clip, huge gray-brown eyes, surprised little O mouth, original chibi identity and head angle. Remove the bottom-right copyright logo; no text or watermark in the output. Change the image treatment to the OTHER portraits in the screenshot: a small centered head-and-shoulders holographic portrait, subdued desaturated gray-blue/cyan colors, soft detailed anime shading and fine horizontal monitor scan lines. The portrait must be roughly 70–75% of the canvas height and width with comfortable transparent margins all around, matching the visual scale of the top-row faces, not an oversized face filling the entire tile. Fade the hair, horns, cheeks' outer silhouette, neck and shoulders gently into true transparency, with a dim semi-transparent cyan haze close to the face. Absolutely NO luminous green circular border, NO ring, NO green disc behind the face, NO thick glowing outline, NO bright pixel/glitch rim, NO badge silhouette, NO opaque rectangle or background panel. Keep just the portrait, intended to sit quietly on the game's near-black #111513 background. Style-match the restrained, low-opacity top-row portraits in image 2, not the loud bottom icon. Check legibility and consistency at 130px and 180px.

copyright: Owner-supplied fan-game artwork. Retain the cosmetic plugin's source/copyright notices; logo removal is only in the rendered icon.
